description: This Java class defines the ProductAvailability entity for the sales manager application. It models product availability, including quantity, dates, regions, status, shipping options, and associated prices, with JPA annotations for ORM mapping.

classes.name: ProductAvailability
classes.description: Entity class representing product availability details such as quantity, date available, region, status, shipping, and prices.

methods.name: defaultPrice
methods.description: Returns the default product price from the associated prices set.

methods.name: getProductQuantity
methods.description: Gets the quantity of the product available.

methods.name: setProductQuantity
methods.description: Sets the quantity of the product available.

methods.name: getProductDateAvailable
methods.description: Gets the date when the product becomes available, cloning the date to prevent external modification.

methods.name: setProductDateAvailable
methods.description: Sets the date when the product becomes available, cloning the input date.

methods.name: getRegion
methods.description: Retrieves the region associated with this availability.

methods.name: setRegion
methods.description: Sets the region for this availability.

methods.name: getRegionVariant
methods.description: Retrieves the region variant.

methods.name: setRegionVariant
methods.description: Sets the region variant.

methods.name: getProductStatus
methods.description: Checks if the product is active/available.

methods.name: setProductStatus
methods.description: Sets the product availability status.

methods.name: getProductIsAlwaysFreeShipping
methods.description: Checks if the product always has free shipping.

methods.name: setProductIsAlwaysFreeShipping
methods.description: Sets the free shipping option for the product.

methods.name: getProductQuantityOrderMin
methods.description: Gets the minimum order quantity.

methods.name: setProductQuantityOrderMin
methods.description: Sets the minimum order quantity.

methods.name: getProductQuantityOrderMax
methods.description: Gets the maximum order quantity.

methods.name: setProductQuantityOrderMax
methods.description: Sets the maximum order quantity.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Gets the entity ID.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the entity ID.

methods.name: getProduct
methods.description: Returns the associated product.

methods.name: setProduct
methods.description: Associates a product with this availability.

methods.name: getPrices
methods.description: Returns the set of product prices.

methods.name: setPrices
methods.description: Sets the product prices.
